user.title: FloLogic
user.description: Connect to your FloLogic account using the same cloud service as the mobile app.

init.title: FloLogic options
init.description: Choose how often Home Assistant refreshes FloLogic data. Keep session alive reuses one cloud websocket, listens for pushed valve updates, and reconnects automatically if FloLogic closes it.

abort.already_configured: This FloLogic device is already configured.
